data: © ESA — first European interplanetary mission; carried Beagle 2; HRSC stereo camera maps Martian topography.

ESA's first interplanetary mission. Carried Beagle 2 to its lost landing. The HRSC stereo camera continues to map Mars at 10 m/pixel; MARSIS subsurface radar discovered evidence of liquid water beneath the south polar cap in 2018.
First European interplanetary mission; first orbital subsurface radar at Mars.
Europe's first mission to another planet; longest-running non-NASA Mars orbiter
ESA's first Mars orbiter; Europe's first planetary mission
